text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Man, it really came down out there, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's so slippery and hard to walk... whoa-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you alright?
It helps to shuffle your feet when walking on snow."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aye, that's it! Take small steps, shuffle your feet,
and lean forward a bit so you won't take a tumble.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It's like the exact opposite of a model walk.
I had no idea.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Leaning forward like this?
Yukino-sensei?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're way too surprised.
Come on, tell me, will you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm... well...! Bend your knees
a little more... like this...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if ya don't lean forward more,
ya'll fall backwards and bump yer head.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"No worries at all! As long as ya remember to fall forward,
ya almost never get seriously hurt, yep."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
As long as you don't let your guard down, snowy roads aren't scary at all!
In fact, they're great for building lower body strength!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... As expected of Professor Yukino.
You're so reliable.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
R-R-Really? If you're fine with somethin' like this,
ask me as much as ya like!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "You're always teaching me about the city, so it feels like today I can finally return the favor~!"
